decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:

A001 - Location Plan - 14/05/2026
A002 - Proposed Site Plan - 14/05/2026
A004 - Design and Access Statement - 14/05/2026
A008 - Proposed Ground and First Floor Plan - 14/05/2026
A009 - Proposed Loft Floor and Roof Plan - 14/05/2026
A010 - Proposed Elevations - 14/05/2026
A011 - Proposed Building Sections 1 and 2 - 14/05/2026

No other drawings or documents apply.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.
description:
DESIGN
The design proposes construction of a 8m Rear Extension.
 
The rear extension will be constructed with a flat roof and there will be a window, a set of French doors to the rear facing  the garden, 2 rooflights  and 1 lantern roof window to the roof.

SCALE
The depth of the rear extension would be 8.0mm (8m being maximum allowable for detached house) with a maximum height of 3.80m and 3.00m at the eaves. 

The open space around the original house would remain approx. 75% of the original open space after the construction of the rear extension which is above 50% benchmark. (Approx. Original 386.76m² and proposed 289.91m²)

MATERIAL
The finish material of the extension would be facing brick to match with existing. The roof will be constructed with fibreglass with top coat finish or felt or similar and the window and the door will be White uPVC.

ACCESS
The existing front access will be used to enter the house.

SUMMARY
The design creates harmonious relationship between the existing and proposed forms with its modest scale and proportion, adopting traditional design and using existing matching materials. It also complies with Schedule-2 Part-1 Class-A of the Town and Country Planning Order 1995. Thus humbly request to grant prior approval.
